pages.title: About A&B Motors
pages.seo_description: A&B Motors has recycled vehicles in Amite, Louisiana since 1958. Three generations, ten acres on Highway 51, and a 90-day warranty on every used part.

pages.title: Tour the Yard
pages.seo_description: Ten acres, a stock number on every part, and photos taken on our own racks. A look behind the used parts A&B Motors sells out of Amite, Louisiana.

pages.title: Sell Your Car for Cash
pages.seo_description: We buy cars and trucks in any condition, running or not. Cash offer over the phone, free towing, and we handle the paperwork. Call 985-748-7195.

pages.title: 90-Day Warranty & Returns
pages.seo_description: Every used part from A&B Motors carries a 90-day money-back warranty from the day it arrives. What is covered, what is not, and how to start a return.

pages.title: Shipping & Delivery
pages.seo_description: Most used parts ship free in the lower 48. Freight is a flat $299.99 or $199.99 to a commercial address. Body panels and glass are pickup or local delivery.

pages.title: Freight & Pickup Rules
pages.seo_description: Which parts ship free, which go LTL freight at a flat rate, and why we do not ship body panels or glass. Read this before ordering a heavy part.

pages.title: Will It Fit My Vehicle?
